reason: My bank app already shows my transfer history, so I don't feel I'm missing anything. I'd have to set up a Shortcut on my iPhone and log into another app just to see slips I can already find in one place.
objection: Why add another app when my bank app already has my history? I don't see what this gives me that I don't already have.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled my K PLUS and credit-card spending into one list that my bank app doesn't show, and the setup took only a few minutes.
